goal.rule: evals/select-places/compare.mjs decides KEEP or REVERT; see its header
order: rubric (test) may not go down beyond noise
checks, rubric or grounded must improve beyond noise (grounded added in run 2 by the user)
holds: style, specific: no drop beyond noise
grounded: test mean drop <= 0.10, per case <= 0.30
no more no-shortlist rows than best
train checks, rubric and grounded: no drop beyond their train floors
goal.noise: computed by compare.mjs from the baseline rows on every run, per split

will_change: prompts/select-places.yaml: system and user text, effort, max_tokens

stopping: run 2: stop after v2 (loop-config.json max_round = 2, enforced by compare.mjs)
lockbox: evals/select-places/lockbox.yaml: scored only on the baseline prompt and the final prompt; never given to an analyzer
analyzer_inputs: per round, a scratch copy of the train-split rows and traces only
config: evals/select-places/loop-config.json (hashed): locked model, reps, train/test split. train_ids/test_ids here are display copies for the report.
round_procedure: 1. Analyzer (fresh agent) gets a scratch copy of train-split rows and traces, the current prompt, metrics.md; proposes one change.
2. Apply the change to prompts/select-places.yaml; save vN/change.md and vN/change.patch.
3. Leak auditor (fresh agent, brief evals/select-places/leak-audit.md) judges the diff against cases.yaml and lockbox.yaml. LEAK: revert without running.
4. npm run eval -- --variant vN --reps 2 (the runner lints the prompt and refuses on a hit).
5. npm run eval:compare -- vN: KEEP records best; REVERT restores the best round's prompt from its prompt.yaml snapshot.
6. Stop after 3 rounds in a row without KEEP, 8 rounds, or the budget. Then run the lockbox on the final prompt and npm run eval:compare -- --lockbox vN.
residual_risk: Agents with file access can read cases.yaml and lockbox.yaml; nothing here can prevent that. Leaks are caught at the output (string lint every run, semantic leak audit every round), not prevented at the input.

adopted.note: User adopted run 2's v2 prompt, overriding compare.mjs's REVERT (test checks -0.038 from a timing-guard false positive on 'today'). state.best is unchanged; compare.mjs's record stands.
